title: Strength to Run
author: Michael S.
desc: Unlock your potential with the "Strength to Run" program, designed to enhance your lower body strength and athletic performance. This focused, single-day weekly workout incorporates bodyweight exercises like Eccentric Reverse Lunges and Bulgarian Split Squats, targeting key muscle groups essential for running efficiency. With a blend of strength and stability drills, you'll build the foundation needed to elevate your running game. Get ready to feel stronger and more agile on your feet!
